integrity: Original algorithm and special initialization credited; independent assessment has not been performed. Analytical theorem is supported by an explicit proof and a noncertifying finite verifier.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic isotropic real quadratic and the original Algorithm 1 with its Option II safeguards; no assertion for anisotropic Hessians, alternate variants, finite precision, or general convex objectives. Earliest source date is the first public arXiv submission, not a journal revision.
title: Exact finite-termination phases and a golden-ratio startup law for AdaBB on isotropic quadratics
